# inngest_signing_keys (Data Source)

Lists the signing keys of an Inngest environment. A deployed app needs its environment's signing key (`INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY`) to talk to Inngest. All branch environments share the same signing key. The `key` values are sensitive.

The Inngest API cannot create or rotate signing keys; rotate them in the dashboard. During a rotation the list can hold two keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "inngest_signing_keys" "staging" {
  environment = "staging"
}

# The signing key, for INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY in the app that serves functions.
output "staging_signing_key" {
  value     = data.inngest_signing_keys.staging.keys[0].key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment` (String) Environment to list signing keys for, sent as the `X-Inngest-Env` header. Defaults to the provider's `environment`; when neither is set, the API lists the production environment's keys.
- `name` (String) Only return keys with exactly this name.

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) The signing keys, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `environment` (String) Environment the key belongs to.
- `id` (String) Key ID.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The key value.
- `name` (String) Key name. Can be empty.
